text:
alex: heads-up: small release tonight 23:00 UTC. api=v2.3.1, runtime=v3.1.0, router unchanged, console patch only. need a quick ack and rollback owner. @priya @tomas

deploy-bot: Window reserved 2026-07-14T23:00Z->23:45Z. Canary plan: 2% 6m -> 10% 12m -> 50%. Auto-rollback triggers: error_rate>4% for 5m OR schema errors.

priya: ack api pin. i'll monitor schema and gateway. rollback owner for api is me.

tomas: runtime ack. i'll be on-call 22:50-23:30. if kernel path shows regressions revert runtime to v3.0.5.

alex: adding manual rollback steps to the release note: 1) abort canary (routerctl stop-shift) 2) pin api back to v2.3.0 (apictl) 3) roll runtime to v3.0.5 if latency persists 4) mark wave ROLLED_BACK and notify #support

deploy-bot: Canary started: 2% at 23:00:00 UTC. Monitoring p50/p95, 5xx, KV latency.

(23:07 UTC) deploy-bot: Alert: p50 latency on API increased to 320ms (baseline 90ms) over 5m. Condition: p50>200ms -> firing.

priya: seeing schema pass but KV latencies spiking in tracing. tomas, can you validate runtime metrics?

tomas: confirming CPU and KV miss rate up on runtime v3.1.0. initiating rollback step 3 now to v3.0.5. I'll run the rollout command and report.

priya: holding traffic shift. routerctl stop-shift -> issued.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift halted by priya at 23:08:20 UTC.

(23:09 UTC) tomas: running `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/runtime runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:v3.0.5` -> rollout started.

deploy-bot: Runtime pods rolling; readiness checks in progress.

(23:12 UTC) tomas: rollout complete. new pods ready with v3.0.5. CPU and KV miss rate back near baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary aborted and reverted to baseline. Wave marked ROLLED_BACK by alex at 23:12:45 UTC.

alex: good work. follow-ups: priya open BUG-2333 with traces, tomas capture kernel logs and attach to bug, keep router unchanged and don't unpin unless ops signoff. I'll update the release notes with rollback reason: "runtime KV latency regression in v3.1.0"

priya: BUG-2333 created and linked to the wave. Drafting short support note for customers.

tomas: saved kernel traces and uploaded to BUG-2333.

alex: closing wave as ROLLED_BACK. we'll re-run a gated canary after runtime fix. thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Wave summary: 1761112223 -> ROLLED_BACK at 2026-07-14T23:12:45Z. Duration ~12m. Trigger: API p50 >200ms due to runtime KV latency. Operators: alex, priya, tomas.

(END)
